{{Quote|I am General Elaxis Frellka of the Republic Strategic High Command. Your incursion here violates the spirit of the Treaty of Coruscant. We have you dead to rights, surrender.|Elaxis Frellka|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Elaxis Frellka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Republic Strategic High Command]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
On the ruined world of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Elaxis Frellka was one of the generals, along with [[Minst]], [[Durant]] and [[Faraire]] who took their actions on strategy and military initiatives against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Residing in a base on Taris, Elaxis led his troops and miners in search for mining materials for the [[Project Siantide]]. However, the operation was [[Destruction of the War Trust|uncovered]] by the [[Empire's Wrath|Sith apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]]. Frellka and his men engaged the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in a fight, but they were all defeated.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}
